params.1273: Use your Home Teleport spell to get back to Burthorpe.
params.1274: You have an unlimited free teleport back to Burthorpe. You should use this whenever you need to get back quickly.
params.1275: Open your Magic Spellbook and click on the Home Teleport icon (an H in a circle) to return to Burthorpe.
params.1276: This spell uses no resources, but takes a while to cast won't work in combat.
params.2225: As you visit other towns you'll be able to teleport to them as well.
